notes.pr: Agents may open full, non-draft PRs from agent/ branches here: Sam is the only collaborator (checked 2026-11-19), so a PR reaches no one else. docs/CONTRACT.md invariant 2 counts this as reversible.
notes.merge: An agent merges only in a thread where Sam typed "full send". The operator itself never merges. A repo without this file is human-only.
